title: Modifier Group Override
description: Item-specific overrides for a modifier group.

minimum_selections.description: Minimum number of selections required from this group for the item.

maximum_selections.description: Maximum number of selections allowed from this group for the item.

allow_quantities.description: Whether modifier options can be selected with quantities greater than 1 for this item.

max_per_modifier.description: Maximum quantity allowed per modifier option for this item.

modifier_option_ids.description: Optional ordered subset override of modifier options available for this item.

metadata.description: Business-defined custom data extending the override.
